tactics:
induction l generalizing i j with
  | nil => simp at h
  | cons a as ih =>
    cases i with
    | zero => simp
    | succ i =>
      simp only [List.zipIdx_cons, List.getElem_cons_succ]
      rw [ih]
      simp only [Prod.mk.injEq, true_and]
      omega
induction l generalizing i j <;> cases i <;> simp_all [List.zipIdx_cons] <;> omega
induction l generalizing i j <;> cases i <;> grind [List.zipIdx_cons]
